assets.role: the ONNX fp32 filler classifier: input (1,480000) float32 = 16 kHz mono up to 30 s, output (1,1499,6) one frame every 20 ms
assets.verified: sha256 from the Hugging Face LFS metadata at the pinned revision and the byte count checked against the resolve content-length on 2026-11-14

assets.role: the six-class id2label order the processor maps frame indices through: 0 not_filler, 1 uh, 2 um, 3 hmm, 4 and, 5 other
assets.verified: sha256 computed from the 237 bytes fetched at the pinned revision on 2026-11-14

pinning.reason: Both artifacts were verified at the pinned Hugging Face revision on 2026-11-14: uhm.onnx against the repository's LFS sha256 plus the resolve content-length, and labels.json by hashing the fetched 237 bytes. Execution qualification is the processor field; the real-inference gate lives in the runtime-onnx package.

qualification.tokenizer: none: uhm consumes a 16 kHz waveform, not tokens
qualification.processor: uhm/waveform-v1: WAV decode (PCM 16-bit and float32, mono or stereo down-mix), linear resample to 16 kHz, 480000-sample chunks with 1 s overlap and a zero-padded final chunk; per-frame argmax, filler when class != 0 and probability >= 0.5; classes 0 not_filler, 1 uh, 2 um, 3 hmm, 4 and, 5 other; spans merged across chunks (one-frame gaps tolerated), confidence = mean, clipped to the audio length
qualification.executionProvider: cpu (ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider; dml/webgpu are optional negotiation lanes)
